decisions.reason: The inverse limit requires every rank N>=0, but the original definition supplies only N>=length(lambda). In particular lambda=(1,1) has no rank-one component. This is an incomplete mathematical construction, not a missing citation. The repair defines all shorter-rank components as zero and proves the missing boundary specialization by a zero numerator row and nonzero specialized Vandermonde.

reviews.reason: Checked the integer polynomial quotient using pairwise nonassociate prime differences, symmetry and homogeneity. Above the length boundary determinant expansion cancels the common product of variables. At rank length(lambda) the numerator specializes to zero and the denominator to a nonzero polynomial, so cancellation forces the next component to zero. Lower components are zero by definition; the empty partition has constant component one even at rank zero. This is the repair author review, not independent review of the repair.
